title: Manifold Fractional Harmonic Transform for 3D Point Clouds
summary: Point clouds can be regarded as discrete samples of smooth manifolds and are typically analyzed via the eigenfunctions of the Laplace-Beltrami operator. This paper extends manifold spectral analysis to the fractional domain, enabling continuous interpolation between the spatial and spectral domains for point cloud data. First, a point cloud manifold fractional harmonic transform (PMFHT) is proposed, with its fundamental properties rigorously derived, along with the associated convolution, correlation, and sampling theorems.
